name: Health & Care

traits: Educational — explain the science, no hype
Bold — confident in results, unafraid of bold claims backed by data
Urgent — time is of the essence; energy and weight are quality-of-life issues
Transparent — honest about what works, what doesn't, why

tone_spectrum.expert_approachable: Expert (science-backed, but explain simply so anyone gets it)
tone_spectrum.emotional_rational: Rational with emotional payoff (lead with science, land on 'feel great again')

do: Use before/afters and testimonials as proof
dont: Never use fake urgency ('only 3 spots left')
Never claim to treat or diagnose medical conditions
Never disparage competitors or other brands
Never use vague wellness language ('life-changing' without proof)
Never oversell — stick to what the products deliver

messaging_house.headline_theme: Transform Your Energy, Reclaim Your Life
messaging_house.social_opener: Tired of supplements that don't work? Science proves ours do.

elevator_pitch: Health & Care is the curated marketplace for weight-loss and energy supplements. We choose products backed by clinical research, not marketing hype. Real results, affordable prices, proven by thousands of happy customers.
boilerplate: Health & Care is a science-backed supplement marketplace dedicated to helping busy adults achieve sustainable weight loss and reclaim their energy. Our curated selection features only clinically proven products at $100–$300, with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Available in the US and Canada.
positioning_tie: For busy adults aged 25–70 seeking sustained energy and weight loss, Health & Care is the curated marketplace of science-backed supplements that delivers transformative results without the hype, because our selection is driven by efficacy research, not profit maximization.
